readings.title: 辦公室的東西 Office Things

qs.q: What is Xiaomei doing Monday morning?
ch: Handing out new supplies from a cart

qs.q: What did the narrator take?
Why does Xiaomei laugh at Xiao Chen?
ch: She just gave him a stapler last month and he lost it

gram.t: Measure words for things — 把, 捲, 本, 台
gram.d: Objects pick their own measure word: 一把剪刀 (graspable handles), 一捲膠帶 (rolls), 一本便利貼 (bound pads/books), 一台影印機 (machines). When in doubt, 個 survives — but the right one is instant fluency points.

readings.title: 蛋捲到了 The Egg Rolls Arrive

qs.q: How did he finally get the egg rolls?
ch: Queued the moment the shop opened at seven

qs.q: How fast did coworkers finish them?
What was the printer's mood today?

gram.d: 完 after a verb marks completion: 印完 finished printing, 吃完 ate it all, 開完會 meeting's over. Chain with 把 for tidy task-talk: 把文件印完 get the documents fully printed. Your Monday to-do list, grammaticalized.

readings.title: 故事⑥:麵的約定 Story ⑥: The Noodle Promise

qs.q: What did the couple agree to do?
ch: Cook noodles for neighbors next typhoon

qs.q: Why cook for the neighbors?
ch: To pass on the warmth the owner gave with one bowl

qs.q: What awaits in Cijin next month?
ch: A lighthouse and an old story

gram.d: 說好 + the arrangement: 我們說好了，颱風來就煮麵。 We agreed: typhoon comes, we cook. 說好六點見 agreed on six o'clock. Break it and the phrase turns accusatory: 你說好要來的！ you PROMISED! Small word, binding contract.

readings.title: 定稿之前 Before the Final Draft

qs.q: What did legal suggest?
ch: Three revisions, mainly the rights section's wording

qs.q: When must the draft be finalized?
Where do the three copies go?
ch: Mr. Wang, legal's files, and the Kaohsiung signing

gram.d: 由 + person/unit + verb assigns responsibility in writing: 修改由我負責 revisions are handled by me, 流程由小美統整 Xiaomei consolidates the process. Meeting minutes and org announcements run on 由 — it's 'by' with a necktie on.

readings.title: 原型測試報告 The Prototype Test Report

qs.q: What happened after the team adjusted the flight-control parameters?
ch: Performance clearly improved — endurance rose from 90 to 105 minutes

qs.q: What does the prototype also beat the previous generation at?
If the next test round goes smoothly, what happens by year's end?

gram.d: 若 (written 如果) pairs with 則 (written 就): 若測試順利，則年底可量產。 If tests go smoothly, then mass production by year's end. Reports, contracts, and specs default to this pair — spot it and you're reading like an engineer.

qs.q: How much may each person take?
What is limited to three?

dict.py: Wǒ bǎ wénjiàn yìn wán le.
dict.en: I finished printing the documents.

dict.py: Bāng wǒ yǐngyìn sān fèn.
dict.en: Photocopy three sets for me.

dict.py: Yìnbiǎojī yòu kǎzhǐ le!
dict.en: The printer jammed again!

dict.py: Qǐng zhǔguǎn zài zhèlǐ gàizhāng.
dict.en: Have the boss stamp here.

dict.py: Lièyìn de shíhòu xuǎn shuāngmiàn.
dict.en: Choose double-sided when printing.

pass.zh: 欸，你買到蛋捲了？！太神啦！大家快來！——嗯！好吃！對了，主管找你，備忘錄印完以後，拿去給他蓋章，他十點要開會，要快喔！

qs.q: What's the reaction to the egg rolls?
What must happen before the boss's ten o'clock meeting?
ch: Bring him the printed memo to stamp

dict.py: Xiàwǔchá yào dìng shénme?
dict.en: What are we ordering for afternoon tea?

dict.zh: 我開一個團購，要的加一！
dict.py: Wǒ kāi yí ge tuángòu, yào de jiā yī!
dict.en: I'm starting a group order — if you're in, plus-one!

dict.py: Jiā yī! Wǒ yào zhēnzhū nǎichá!
dict.en: Plus one! Pearl milk tea for me!

dict.py: Chōutì lǐ hái yǒu yìxiē língshí.
dict.en: There are still snacks in the drawer.

dict.py: Sān diǎn de shíhòu yǐnliào huì dào.
dict.en: The drinks arrive at three.

pass.zh: 群組訊息：「今天下午茶我開團，隔壁新開的手搖飲，要的加一，順便寫甜度冰塊！三十杯以上打八折，大家快揪！兩點收單喔！」

qs.q: What should people include with their 'plus one'?
What triggers the twenty-percent discount?

dict.zh: 法務提了三個修訂的建議。
dict.py: Fǎwù tí le sān ge xiūdìng de jiànyì.
dict.en: Legal raised three revision suggestions.

dict.py: Míngtiān zhōngwǔ qián yào dìnggǎo.

dict.py: Yí fèn jīntiān jiù yào jìchū.
dict.en: One copy must be sent out today.

dict.py: Xiūgǎi de gōngzuò yóu wǒ fùzé.
dict.en: The revisions are handled by me.

pass.zh: 進度確認:備忘錄的修訂今天下班前完成,明天早上法務再看最後一次,中午定稿。定稿之後,小美印副本,一份掛號寄出給王先生,寄出以後把單號傳到群組,讓大家放心。

qs.q: When does legal take its final look?
What should be shared to the group after mailing?

dict.py: Yuánxíng jìnrù dì èr lún cèshì.
dict.en: The prototype entered its second round of testing.

dict.zh: 調整參數之後，效能明顯提升。
dict.py: Tiáozhěng cānshù zhīhòu, xiàonéng míngxiǎn tíshēng.
dict.en: After parameter adjustments, performance clearly improved.

dict.zh: 續航提高到一百零五分鐘。
dict.py: Xùháng tígāo dào yìbǎi líng wǔ fēnzhōng.
dict.en: Endurance rose to one hundred five minutes.

dict.zh: 若測試順利，則年底進入量產。
dict.py: Ruò cèshì shùnlì, zé niándǐ jìnrù liàngchǎn.
dict.en: If tests go smoothly, mass production starts by year's end.

dict.zh: 強風下的穩定表現優於上一代。
dict.py: Qiáng fēng xià de wěndìng biǎoxiàn yōuyú shàng yí dài.
dict.en: Stability in strong wind exceeds the previous generation.

pass.zh: 測試簡報：第二輪重點有三。第一，新參數讓續航多了十五分鐘。第二，抗風測試全部通過，數據比上一代好百分之二十。第三，還有一個小問題：低溫的時候，電池效能會下降，工程團隊下週處理。整體來說，量產的目標不變。

qs.q: How much better is the wind-resistance data than the previous generation?
What small problem remains?
ch: Battery performance drops in low temperatures

scenarios.intro: The supply cart cometh. State your needs clearly and guard your stapler with your life.

them.zh: 早安！新的東西到了，你需要什麼？
them.py: Zǎo'ān! Xīn de dōngxi dào le, nǐ xūyào shénme?
them.en: Morning! New supplies are here — what do you need?

turns.task: A pair of scissors and a roll of tape.

ans.zh: 我要一把剪刀跟一捲膠帶。
ans.py: Wǒ yào yì bǎ jiǎndāo gēn yì juǎn jiāodài.
ans.en: One pair of scissors and a roll of tape, please.

them.zh: 好！便利貼要不要？有黃色跟藍色的。
them.py: Hǎo! Biànlìtiē yào bú yào? Yǒu huángsè gēn lánsè de.
them.en: Done! Sticky notes? We have yellow and blue.

turns.task: Yellow — you use them the most.

ans.zh: 要黃色的，我最常用便利貼！
ans.py: Yào huángsè de, wǒ zuì cháng yòng biànlìtiē!
ans.en: Yellow — I use sticky notes the most!

them.zh: 訂書機呢？你的還在嗎？
them.py: Dìngshūjī ne? Nǐ de hái zài ma?
them.en: And a stapler? Is yours still around?

turns.task: Still there — it's in your drawer.

ans.zh: 還在，在我的抽屜裡！
ans.py: Hái zài, zài wǒ de chōutì lǐ!
ans.en: Still here — it's in my drawer!

them.zh: 很好！不像小陳，上個月才拿一個就不見了！
them.py: Hěn hǎo! Bú xiàng Xiǎo Chén, shàng ge yuè cái ná yí ge jiù bújiàn le!
them.en: Good! Unlike Xiao Chen — got one last month and it's already gone!

turns.task: Laugh — maybe it's hiding under his egg-roll crumbs.

ans.zh: 哈哈，可能在他的蛋捲下面吧！
ans.py: Hāhā, kěnéng zài tā de dànjuǎn xiàmiàn ba!
ans.en: Haha — probably hiding under his egg rolls!

them.zh: 哈哈！好了，東西給你，要放好喔！
them.py: Hāhā! Hǎo le, dōngxi gěi nǐ, yào fàng hǎo ō!
them.en: Haha! Here you go — put them away properly!

turns.task: Thank her and promise to keep things tidy.

ans.zh: 謝謝小美，我一定放好！
ans.py: Xièxiè Xiǎoměi, wǒ yídìng fàng hǎo!
ans.en: Thanks, Xiaomei — everything in its place, promise!

scenarios.intro: Egg-roll glory fades fast — the boss's 10 AM meeting looms and the documents won't copy themselves.

them.zh: 蛋捲太好吃了！你真的七點就去排喔？
them.py: Dànjuǎn tài hǎochī le! Nǐ zhēn de qī diǎn jiù qù pái ō?
them.en: The egg rolls were amazing! You really queued at seven?

turns.task: Yep — the moment the shop opened; you keep your promises.

ans.zh: 對啊，店一開我就去排，我說到做到！
ans.py: Duì a, diàn yì kāi wǒ jiù qù pái, wǒ shuōdào zuòdào!
ans.en: Yep — queued the second they opened. I keep my word!

them.zh: 佩服！欸，主管十點開會，文件印了沒？
them.py: Pèifú! Éi, zhǔguǎn shí diǎn kāihuì, wénjiàn yìn le méi?
them.en: Respect! Hey — boss's meeting is at ten. Documents printed?

turns.task: Printed — now you need to photocopy three sets.

ans.zh: 印完了，現在要去影印三份。
ans.py: Yìn wán le, xiànzài yào qù yǐngyìn sān fèn.
ans.en: All printed — now off to photocopy three sets.

them.zh: 影印機早上怪怪的，你小心卡紙！
them.py: Yǐngyìnjī zǎoshàng guàiguài de, nǐ xiǎoxīn kǎzhǐ!
them.en: The copier was acting weird this morning — watch for jams!

turns.task: If it jams, you'll use the printer on the third floor instead.

ans.zh: 如果卡紙，我就去三樓用那台印表機。
ans.py: Rúguǒ kǎzhǐ, wǒ jiù qù sān lóu yòng nà tái yìnbiǎojī.
ans.en: If it jams, I'll use the third-floor printer.

them.zh: 聰明！印完別忘了給主管蓋章！
them.py: Cōngmíng! Yìn wán bié wàng le gěi zhǔguǎn gàizhāng!
them.en: Smart! And don't forget the boss's stamp after copying!

turns.task: On it — copy first, stamp second, all before ten.

ans.zh: 放心，先影印再蓋章，十點以前全部做完！
ans.py: Fàngxīn, xiān yǐngyìn zài gàizhāng, shí diǎn yǐqián quánbù zuò wán!
ans.en: Relax — copy first, stamp second, all done before ten!

them.zh: 效率！那我去訂下午茶，等一下問你要喝什麼！
them.py: Xiàolǜ! Nà wǒ qù dìng xiàwǔchá, děng yíxià wèn nǐ yào hē shénme!
them.en: Efficiency! I'll go set up afternoon tea — I'll ask your order in a bit!

turns.task: Deal — you already know: half sugar, no ice.

ans.zh: 好，我先跟你說：半糖去冰！
ans.py: Hǎo, wǒ xiān gēn nǐ shuō: bàntáng qùbīng!
ans.en: Deal — I'll tell you now: half sugar, no ice!

scenarios.intro: 2 PM. The group chat stirs. Somewhere, a drink shop is about to receive a thirty-cup order. This is Taiwanese office culture at its purest.

them.zh: 下午茶開團囉！隔壁新開的手搖飲，要的加一！
them.py: Xiàwǔchá kāituán lo! Gébì xīn kāi de shǒuyáoyǐn, yào de jiā yī!
them.en: Afternoon-tea group order is open! The new drink shop next door — plus-one if you're in!

turns.task: Plus one! Pearl milk tea, light sugar, less ice.

ans.zh: 加一！珍珠奶茶，微糖少冰！
ans.py: Jiā yī! Zhēnzhū nǎichá, wéitáng shǎobīng!
ans.en: Plus one! Pearl milk tea, light sugar, less ice!

them.zh: 收到！現在二十八杯了，三十杯以上打八折！
them.py: Shōudào! Xiànzài èrshíbā bēi le, sānshí bēi yǐshàng dǎ bāzhé!
them.en: Got it! We're at twenty-eight cups — thirty or more gets twenty percent off!

turns.task: Only two more needed — go ask the third floor.

ans.zh: 只差兩杯了，去問三樓的同事啊！
ans.py: Zhǐ chà liǎng bēi le, qù wèn sān lóu de tóngshì a!
ans.en: Just two short — go ask the third floor!

them.zh: 三樓加了五杯！八折到手！兩點半收單！
them.py: Sān lóu jiā le wǔ bēi! Bāzhé dàoshǒu! Liǎng diǎn bàn shōudān!
them.en: Third floor added five! Discount secured! Orders close at two thirty!

turns.task: Nice — ask who's picking up the drinks.

ans.zh: 太好了！那等一下誰去拿飲料？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Nà děng yíxià shéi qù ná yǐnliào?
ans.en: Excellent! So who's picking up the drinks?

them.zh: 我去！可是三十三杯，我一個人拿不動……
them.py: Wǒ qù! Kěshì sānshísān bēi, wǒ yí ge rén ná bú dòng……
them.en: I'll go! But thirty-three cups… I can't carry that alone…

turns.task: Volunteer to go with him — you'll bring the office cart.

ans.zh: 我跟你去，我們推小美的推車去載！
ans.py: Wǒ gēn nǐ qù, wǒmen tuī Xiǎoměi de tuīchē qù zài!
ans.en: I'll come — we'll take Xiaomei's cart to haul them!

them.zh: 天才！這就是團隊合作！三點見！
them.py: Tiāncái! Zhè jiùshì tuánduì hézuò! Sān diǎn jiàn!
them.en: Genius! THIS is teamwork! See you at three!

turns.task: Laugh — thirty-three cups is today's most important mission.

ans.zh: 哈哈，三十三杯飲料，今天最重要的任務！
ans.py: Hāhā, sānshísān bēi yǐnliào, jīntiān zuì zhòngyào de rènwù!
ans.en: Haha — thirty-three drinks, today's most critical mission!

scenarios.intro: The MOU is one revision cycle from done. Xiaomei is coordinating copies, mail, and the signing folder — sync with her.

them.zh: 法務的修訂建議你看了嗎？改得完嗎？
them.py: Fǎwù de xiūdìng jiànyì nǐ kàn le ma? Gǎi de wán ma?
them.en: Did you see legal's revision suggestions? Can you finish the changes?

turns.task: Seen — three suggestions, mainly the rights section; you'll finish by end of day.

ans.zh: 看了，三個修訂，主要是權益那段的文字，我今天下班前改完。
ans.py: Kàn le, sān ge xiūdìng, zhǔyào shì quányì nà duàn de wénzì, wǒ jīntiān xiàbān qián gǎi wán.
ans.en: Yes — three revisions, mainly the rights section's wording. Done by end of day.

them.zh: 好！那明天中午定稿，來得及嗎？
them.py: Hǎo! Nà míngtiān zhōngwǔ dìnggǎo, lái de jí ma?
them.en: Good! Final version by noon tomorrow — doable?

turns.task: Yes — legal reviews once more in the morning, then it's locked at noon.

ans.zh: 來得及，明天早上法務再看最後一次，中午就定稿。
ans.py: Lái de jí, míngtiān zǎoshàng fǎwù zài kàn zuìhòu yí cì, zhōngwǔ jiù dìnggǎo.
ans.en: Doable — legal takes a final look in the morning, and we lock it at noon.

them.zh: 定稿之後我印三份副本，怎麼分？
them.py: Dìnggǎo zhīhòu wǒ yìn sān fèn fùběn, zěnme fēn?
them.en: After it's final I'll print three copies — where do they go?

turns.task: One mailed to Mr. Wang, one filed with legal, one in the Kaohsiung signing folder.

ans.zh: 一份寄出給王先生，一份給法務存檔，一份放進高雄簽約的資料夾。
ans.py: Yí fèn jìchū gěi Wáng xiānshēng, yí fèn gěi fǎwù cúndǎng, yí fèn fàng jìn Gāoxióng qiānyuē de zīliàojiā.
ans.en: One mailed to Mr. Wang, one filed with legal, one into the Kaohsiung signing folder.

them.zh: 寄王先生那份用掛號嗎？
them.py: Jì Wáng xiānshēng nà fèn yòng guàhào ma?
them.en: Registered mail for Mr. Wang's copy?

turns.task: Yes — registered, and share the tracking number to the group after sending.

ans.zh: 對，用掛號，寄出以後把單號傳到群組，大家都放心。
ans.py: Duì, yòng guàhào, jìchū yǐhòu bǎ dānhào chuán dào qúnzǔ, dàjiā dōu fàngxīn.
ans.en: Yes, registered — and post the tracking number to the group after it's sent.

them.zh: 完美。主管說得對：文件寧可早，不要趕！
them.py: Wánměi. Zhǔguǎn shuō de duì: wénjiàn níngkě zǎo, búyào gǎn!
them.en: Perfect. The boss is right: documents early, never rushed!

turns.task: Agree — early and steady; one week to Kaohsiung.

ans.zh: 沒錯，早一點、穩一點。再一個星期就去高雄了！
ans.py: Méicuò, zǎo yìdiǎn, wěn yìdiǎn. Zài yí ge xīngqí jiù qù Gāoxióng le!
ans.en: Exactly — early and steady. One more week and we're off to Kaohsiung!

scenarios.intro: Round two of prototype testing is in. The boss wants numbers, risks, and a straight answer on mass production.

them.zh: 第二輪測試的結果怎麼樣？
them.py: Dì èr lún cèshì de jiéguǒ zěnmeyàng?
them.en: How did the second round of testing go?

turns.task: Strong — after parameter adjustments, endurance rose from ninety to one hundred five minutes.

ans.zh: 很好。調整參數之後，續航從九十分鐘提高到一百零五分鐘。
ans.py: Hěn hǎo. Tiáozhěng cānshù zhīhòu, xùháng cóng jiǔshí fēnzhōng tígāo dào yìbǎi líng wǔ fēnzhōng.
ans.en: Strong — after the parameter adjustments, endurance rose from ninety to one hundred five minutes.

them.zh: 抗風的部分呢？上一代在這裡吃過虧。
them.py: Kàngfēng de bùfèn ne? Shàng yí dài zài zhèlǐ chī guò kuī.
them.en: And wind resistance? The last generation got burned there.

turns.task: All tests passed — data is twenty percent better than the previous generation.

ans.zh: 全部通過，數據比上一代好百分之二十，強風下的效能很穩定。
ans.py: Quánbù tōngguò, shùjù bǐ shàng yí dài hǎo bǎifēnzhī èrshí, qiáng fēng xià de xiàonéng hěn wěndìng.
ans.en: All passed — data beats the last generation by twenty percent, with stable performance in strong wind.

them.zh: 有沒有需要注意的風險？老實說。
them.py: Yǒu méiyǒu xūyào zhùyì de fēngxiǎn? Lǎoshí shuō.
them.en: Any risks I should know about? Be honest.

turns.task: One: battery performance drops in low temperatures — engineering addresses it next week.

ans.zh: 有一個：低溫的時候電池效能會下降，工程團隊下週處理，展覽前一定解決。
ans.py: Yǒu yí ge: dīwēn de shíhòu diànchí xiàonéng huì xiàjiàng, gōngchéng tuánduì xià zhōu chǔlǐ, zhǎnlǎn qián yídìng jiějué.
ans.en: One — battery performance drops in the cold. Engineering tackles it next week; it'll be solved before the expo.

them.zh: 好。那量產的時間表，你的判斷是什麼？
them.py: Hǎo. Nà liàngchǎn de shíjiānbiǎo, nǐ de pànduàn shì shénme?
them.en: Good. And the mass-production timeline — your judgment?

turns.task: If round three goes smoothly, mass production by year's end — the expo debut will be a real, buyable product.

ans.zh: 若第三輪順利，則年底就能進入量產。這樣展覽上的亮相就不只是概念，而是買得到的產品。
ans.py: Ruò dì sān lún shùnlì, zé niándǐ jiù néng jìnrù liàngchǎn. Zhèyàng zhǎnlǎn shàng de liàngxiàng jiù bù zhǐshì gàiniàn, ér shì mǎi de dào de chǎnpǐn.
ans.en: If round three goes smoothly, mass production by year's end — so the expo debut isn't a concept, it's a product you can buy.

them.zh: 很好。簽約、參展、量產——這個秋天，一步都不能錯。
them.py: Hěn hǎo. Qiānyuē, cānzhǎn, liàngchǎn — zhège qiūtiān, yí bù dōu bùnéng cuò.
them.en: Good. Signing, expo, production — this autumn, not one step can go wrong.

turns.task: Commit — the plan is clear, the team is ready, and you'll take it one solid step at a time.

ans.zh: 明白。計畫很清楚，團隊也準備好了，我們一步一步穩穩地走。
ans.py: Míngbái. Jìhuà hěn qīngchǔ, tuánduì yě zhǔnbèi hǎo le, wǒmen yí bù yí bù wěnwěn de zǒu.
ans.en: Understood. The plan is clear, the team is ready — we take it one steady step at a time.

x: 我需要一把剪刀。
Wǒ xūyào yì bǎ jiǎndāo.
I need a pair of scissors.
vocab.n: 剪 cut + 刀 blade; measure word 把. Same 剪 as 剪頭髮 — one character, salon to desk.

x: 膠帶用完了。
Jiāodài yòng wán le.
The tape is used up.
vocab.n: 膠 glue + 帶 strip; measure word 捲 (roll). Typhoon flashback: taping windows is a 防颱 classic (that experts now discourage!).

x: 訂書機在桌上。
Dìngshūjī zài zhuō shàng.
The stapler is on the desk.
vocab.n: 訂 bind + 書 papers + 機 machine. Staples are 訂書針. Office law: staplers vanish; guard yours.

x: 給我一張便利貼。
Gěi wǒ yì zhāng biànlìtiē.
Hand me a sticky note.
vocab.n: 便利 convenient + 貼 stick — same 便利 as 便利商店. Post-it by any other name.

x: 幫我影印三份。
Bāng wǒ yǐngyìn sān fèn.
Photocopy three sets for me.
vocab.n: 影 image + 印 print: copying an existing page. 影印機 the copier. Documents count with 份.

x: 列印的時候選雙面。
Lièyìn de shíhòu xuǎn shuāngmiàn.
Choose double-sided when printing.
vocab.n: Taiwan says 列印; the mainland says 打印. 影印 copies paper, 列印 prints from screen — offices use both daily.

x: 印表機又卡紙了！
Yìnbiǎojī yòu kǎzhǐ le!
The printer jammed again!
vocab.n: Taiwan's word; mainland says 打印機. 卡紙 paper jam — the printer's favorite hobby. 沒墨水了 = out of ink, its second.

x: 請主管在這裡蓋章。
Qǐng zhǔguǎn zài zhèlǐ gàizhāng.
Have the boss stamp here.
vocab.n: 蓋 press + 章 seal. In Taiwan the personal seal (印章) still outranks signatures for banks and contracts — 簽名蓋章 covers both.

x: 我開一個團購，要的加一！
Wǒ kāi yí ge tuángòu, yào de jiā yī!
Starting a group buy — plus-one if you're in!
vocab.n: 團 group + 購 purchase: bulk orders for bulk discounts. 開團 start one, 跟團 join one, 收單 close orders. An office institution.

x: 下午茶要訂什麼？
Xiàwǔchá yào dìng shénme?
What are we ordering for afternoon tea?
vocab.n: Less British ceremony, more 3 PM drinks-and-fried-chicken delivery. 訂下午茶 is a legitimate office duty in Taiwan.

x: 抽屜裡還有一些零食。
Chōutì lǐ hái yǒu yìxiē língshí.
There are still snacks in the drawer.
vocab.n: 零 scattered + 食 food: eating between meals. 零食櫃 the office snack cabinet — morale infrastructure.

x: 要的加一！——加一！
Yào de jiā yī! — Jiā yī!
Plus-one if you want in! — Plus one!
vocab.n: THE group-buy reply: each joiner types 加一 (or +1) in the chat. Beyond shopping: agreement, attendance, solidarity. Two syllables of pure Taiwanese office culture.

vocab.e: to finalize a draft; final version
x: 明天中午前要定稿。
Míngtiān zhōngwǔ qián yào dìnggǎo.
Finalize the draft before noon tomorrow.
vocab.n: 定 fix + 稿 draft: the moment edits stop. 草稿 draft → 修訂 revise → 定稿 lock. Publishing and contracts both live on this verb.

x: 法務提了三個修訂的建議。
Fǎwù tí le sān ge xiūdìng de jiànyì.
Legal raised three revision suggestions.
vocab.n: 修 fix + 訂 settle: formal document revision. 修訂版 revised edition; laws get 修訂 too. Heavier than casual 修改.

x: 副本印三份。
Fùběn yìn sān fèn.
Print three duplicate copies.
vocab.n: 副 secondary + 本 volume: the copies versus 正本 the original. Email CC is also 副本 — 密件副本 = BCC. Bureaucracy's favorite noun.

x: 一份今天就要寄出。
Yí fèn jīntiān jiù yào jìchū.
One copy must go out today.
vocab.n: 寄 mail + 出 out. 掛號 registered mail, 單號 tracking number. Emails 寄出 too — 信寄出去了嗎？ did it send?

x: 原型進入第二輪測試。
Yuánxíng jìnrù dì èr lún cèshì.
The prototype entered round-two testing.
vocab.n: 原 original + 型 form. 原型機 the prototype unit. Also literary: 打回原形 revert to true form — engineering and mythology share a word.

x: 調整參數之後，效能明顯提升。
Tiáozhěng cānshù zhīhòu, xiàonéng míngxiǎn tíshēng.
After adjusting parameters, performance clearly improved.
vocab.n: 調參數 tune parameters — engineering's daily verb. 設定參數 set them, 跑參數 run them. Your lab vocabulary, now in Mandarin.

x: 若測試順利，年底進入量產。
Ruò cèshì shùnlì, niándǐ jìnrù liàngchǎn.
If tests go well, mass production starts by year's end.
vocab.n: 量 quantity + 產 produce: from prototype to production line. 進入量產 / 量產階段 — the phrase every hardware startup dreams in.

x: 低溫的時候電池效能會下降。
Dīwēn de shíhòu diànchí xiàonéng huì xiàjiàng.
Battery performance drops in low temperatures.
vocab.n: 效 effect + 能 capability: Taiwan's tech-spec word where 性能 also appears. 高效能 high-performance; 效能測試 benchmark testing.

slang.e: banging the bowl — loudly demanding something
x: 同事一直敲碗，問蛋捲什麼時候再買。
Tóngshì yìzhí qiāowǎn, wèn dànjuǎn shénme shíhòu zài mǎi.
Coworkers keep banging the bowl asking when the next egg-roll run is.
slang.n: Like kids banging bowls before dinner: fans 敲碗 a sequel, coworkers 敲碗 snacks. 敲碗等更新 = impatiently demanding the next episode.

x: 我今天有週一症候群，先來一杯咖啡再說。
Wǒ jīntiān yǒu zhōuyī zhènghòuqún, xiān lái yì bēi kāfēi zài shuō.
Monday syndrome has me — coffee first, everything else later.
slang.n: 症候群 = syndrome, applied to the Monday condition. Symptoms: 起不來, 不想上班. The universal diagnosis with no cure but Friday.

x: 還好我們組沒有雷包，事情都準時做完。
Háihǎo wǒmen zǔ méiyǒu léibāo, shìqíng dōu zhǔnshí zuò wán.
Thankfully no duds on our team — everything lands on time.
slang.n: 雷 landmine + 包 bundle: a person who IS the landmine. Group projects fear them; 掃雷 is checking for them before teaming up.

slang.e: my heart is so tired — emotionally drained
x: 改了五次還要再改，心好累。
Gǎi le wǔ cì hái yào zài gǎi, xīn hǎo lèi.
Five revisions and counting — my soul is exhausted.
slang.n: Not body-tired (累) but heart-tired: bureaucracy, group chats, printers. Deploy with a sigh for full effect.

x: 群組問誰要去拿飲料，一半的人都在裝死。
Qúnzǔ wèn shéi yào qù ná yǐnliào, yíbàn de rén dōu zài zhuāngsǐ.
The chat asked who'd fetch the drinks — half the group is playing dead.
slang.n: 裝 pretend + 死 dead: seen-but-silent when work is being assigned. The passive cousin of 已讀不回 — you don't even leave a read receipt.
